run_expire_all_units: run the script to expire all units for a specific Mephisto task in the local database
run_main: run the main function to find tasks and set all their units to expired status
review_main: review the main function that iterates through task runs, assignments, and units to expire them
summarize_main: summarize the main function that uses LocalMephistoDB to find and expire all units for a task
refactor_main: refactor the main function to accept a task name as a CLI argument instead of hardcoding it
